truthAudit.Summary: Run 1 detected most Run 3 truth vulnerabilities but missed persistent authentication state, unhandled exception in variable parsing, and TOCTOU in config loading. Several detections had wrong CWE or severity, and three extra findings are not credited as Run 3 truth items.
